device_template.name: Seplos BMS V2 pack (inter-pack tap, listen-only)
device_template.author: Stefan Maldaianu
device_template.description: One Seplos V2 slave pack of a parallel bank, HEARD on the inter-pack RS485 bus, where the master pack asks each slave for a summary (CID2 0x5A) about once a second. protocol seplos_v2 (a serial port here) or seplos_v2-tcp (a bridge's raw TCP port) with connection.mode listen: the template refuses poll, and the gateway never transmits on that bus. Set unit_id to the pack's ADR (1, 2, ...). The master pack is not on this bus: read it from the CAN link with pylontech_can_inverter. The 0x5A layout is in no published document: it was read off a bench capture (3 x 280 Ah packs, 2026-10-26) and checked against the CAN link of the same bank; each row's description says verified or ASSUMED. The summary carries no per-cell voltages, no cycles and no alarms. Names are the canonical battery names (docs/canonical-fields.md).
device_template.source_document: No published layout for CID2 0x5A: the Seplos 'BMS communication protocol V2.0' covers 0x42/0x44/0x47/0x51, and no community decoder handled 0x5A (searched 2026-10-26). Layout from the passive capture tests/fixtures/seplos_v2/ttySC0-interpack-20261026.capture (mbg-bench, listen-only), cross-checked with the CAN 0x355/0x356/0x370 frames of the same bank.

tap.description: informational: the master asks each slave about once a second

notes.text: Listen only. The master pack polls this bus, and a question from the gateway collides with it (seen on the bench). Saving refuses mode poll.
Freshness: values arrive on each master poll (about 1 s). Set the connection's stale_after_s (10 s suits) so a pack the master stops asking shows stale, not frozen.
Raw words kept for the bench: their meaning is not known yet.
ASSUMED, not verified: the port voltage word, and which sensors the temperature extremes cover.

registers.name: pack_voltage
registers.label: Pack voltage
registers.description: 0x5A word 6, 0.01 V. Verified on the bench capture (2026-10-26): 52.35 / 52.31 V; the CAN link said 52.24 V for the bank.

registers.name: battery_current
registers.label: Current (+ charging)
registers.description: 0x5A word 5, int16 0.01 A, + charging. Verified on the bench capture (2026-10-26): -0.48 / -0.45 A in the evening, discharging like the bank on the CAN link. The sign follows 0x42; a capture while charging is still to come.

registers.name: soc
registers.label: State of charge
registers.description: 0x5A word 9, 0.1 %. Verified on the bench capture (2026-10-26): 33.4 / 20.5 %, exactly remaining / full truncated to 0.1 % on all 120 answers.

registers.name: remaining_capacity
registers.label: Remaining capacity
registers.description: 0x5A word 7, 0.01 Ah. Verified on the bench capture (2026-10-26): 93.71 / 57.41 Ah (x 100 / full = SOC).

registers.name: total_capacity
registers.label: Full capacity
registers.description: 0x5A word 8, 0.01 Ah. Verified on the bench capture (2026-10-26): 280.00 Ah per pack (840 Ah for the three).

registers.name: max_cell_voltage
registers.label: Highest cell
registers.description: 0x5A word 1, mV. Verified on the bench capture (2026-10-26): 3.274 / 3.278 V, inside the 3.23-3.29 V of CAN 0x370 that evening.

registers.name: min_cell_voltage
registers.label: Lowest cell
registers.description: 0x5A word 2, mV. Verified on the bench capture (2026-10-26): 3.269 / 3.241 V.

registers.name: temp_max
registers.label: Highest temperature
registers.description: 0x5A word 3, 0.1 K (offset 2731). Verified on the bench capture (2026-10-26): 24.5 °C, exactly the bank maximum in CAN 0x370. Which sensors it covers (cells only, or ambient and MOSFET too) is ASSUMED.

registers.name: temp_min
registers.label: Lowest temperature
registers.description: 0x5A word 4, 0.1 K. Verified on the bench capture (2026-10-26): 22.7 °C on pack 2, exactly the bank minimum in CAN 0x370.

registers.name: port_voltage
registers.label: Port voltage
registers.description: 0x5A word 10, 0.01 V. ASSUMED: read as the port voltage of 0x42 because it sits 0.06 V above the pack voltage; being above it while discharging is not explained.

registers.name: summary_head
registers.label: Summary word 0
registers.description: 0x5A word 0, raw. ASSUMED: DATAFLAG and a group byte as in 0x42; 0x0001 on both packs.

registers.name: summary_word_11
registers.label: Summary word 11
registers.description: 0x5A word 11, raw, not understood yet (0 on the bench: an alarm or status word?).

registers.name: summary_word_12
registers.label: Summary word 12
registers.description: 0x5A word 12, raw, not understood yet (0 on the bench).

registers.name: summary_word_13
registers.label: Summary word 13
registers.description: 0x5A word 13, raw, not understood yet (0 on the bench).

registers.name: summary_word_14
registers.label: Summary word 14
registers.description: 0x5A word 14, raw, not understood yet (0x0302 on both packs).

registers.name: summary_word_15
registers.label: Summary word 15
registers.description: 0x5A word 15, raw, not understood yet (0x8010 on pack 1, 0x8001 on pack 2).

registers.name: summary_length
registers.label: Summary length
registers.description: Bytes of INFO in the 0x5A answer (32 on the bench).

registers.name: response_ms
registers.label: Response time
registers.description: The master's request to this pack's answer, as heard.

registers.name: checksum_errors
registers.label: Checksum errors
registers.description: Corrupted frames charged to this pack (the one whose answer was awaited).

registers.name: rtn_errors
registers.label: Error answers
registers.description: Answers with a return code other than 0.

registers.name: good_answers
registers.label: Good answers
registers.description: Decoded answers, mod 65536.

registers.name: decode_errors
registers.label: Undecodable answers
registers.description: Answers whose INFO was too short to decode.
